survey.readings: Axis 287.2 degrees counter-clockwise from east (front to the canal, north-north-east). Front 18.6 m wide; nave 11.2 m (eaves 22 m, ridge 25.6 m), aisles to 14.6-16.2 m, a transept of the nave's height crossing at 4.5 m behind the middle, a low lantern over the crossing (27.2 m), back annexes 8-12 m. 3DBAG front top 27.3 m.

facadeRhythm.north front (Prinsengracht): Symmetric, grey sandstone. Lower storey (to 12.6 m): three bays; single pilasters at the ends, paired pilasters either side of the centre bay. Centre: the great door, an arched tympanum with the gold mosaic, the blue inscription tablet (IN LOCO ISTO DABO PACEM). Side bays: a small door under a pediment hood, a round-headed niche with a statue above it. Entablature, then an attic band to 15.8 m with obelisks at the ends. Raised centre of nave width: paired pilasters at each edge, one tall round-arched window, entablature and a pediment to 27.3 m with a cross; concave scrolls join it to the attic ends.
facadeRhythm.flanks: Party walls against the neighbouring canal houses up to the aisle eaves (no openings); above them the nave clerestory and the transept ends. Inferred, not photographed from outside: three round-arched clerestory windows a side, one large arched window over a smaller one at each transept end (the interior photos show arched clerestory and transept windows).
facadeRhythm.south back (Kerkstraat): Brick nave end with corner pilaster strips and a tall round-arched window high up; lower brick annexes either side with two rows of windows (RCE 1970; counts on the annexes are approximate).
facadeRhythm.roofs: Pitched slate roofs of a low pitch on the nave and the transept (crossing at right angles), lean-to aisle roofs, a small lead octagonal lantern with a low cap over the crossing, near-flat roofs on the back annexes. Nothing from the 3DBAG roof meshes.

colours.sampled: RM4658 (overcast, 2012): sandstone lit #b6b1b0, shaded #7d7978, upper #9a8f86; doors #60615d. Duif0201 is backlit (#565646) and not used for colour.
colours.chosen: stone #c9c4bc (the front faces north-north-east and is always in the game's shade; first try #b3ada6 rendered #5a5c5c, too dark against the photo), plinth #9d9993, brick #7c6256, slate #5e6168, mosaic #c49a4a, tablet #2f4f86, lead #9aa3ac.

decisions: Plan and heights from BAG/3DBAG; all roofs and facades from intent and photographs.
Flank and transept windows are inferred (the church is built in between canal houses; no outside photos of them).
The crossing lantern is a low lead octagon as 3DBAG shows (1.6 m above the ridges); its exact form is not photographed.

The first build mirrored the plan across the church axis (plan readings take b to the left of the axis, the kit's local z runs to the right); scripts/landmarks/footprint-fit.ts caught it (77% -> 99% of the BAG footprint covered) and the builder now uses localB.
